summary: In code, fs.rm(path, { recursive: true, force: true }) (Node 14.14+) replaces rimraf. rimraf <4 is flagged unsupported on npm. rimraf 6 is fine as a cross-platform CLI in package.json scripts.

replacements.name: fs.rm
replacements.when: await fs.promises.rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })
